capabilities: Toggle fullscreen focus mode for the active leaf
Trigger the mode from the command palette or a keyboard shortcut
Restore the previous layout by pressing Esc
extras: README is only two sentences and covers no setup, screenshots, or troubleshooting.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view a single note fullscreen and distraction-free without closing or rearranging panes.
summary: Adds a command and hotkey that put the active note into a fullscreen focus mode, with Esc restoring the previous layout.
